figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Identification and functional characterization of the BGC
for 1. (A) The nghh cluster is identified in Nigrospora sp. TCN-5. The
BGC for 1 identified in Fusarium sp. RK97-94 is shown for
comparison. The identity and similarity values between amino acid
sequences in the corresponding enzymes are shown in parentheses.
KS, ketosynthase; AT, acyltransferase; DH, dehydratase; MT,
methyltransferase; ER, enoylreductase; KR, ketoreductase; ACP,
acyl carrier protein. (B) HPLC analysis of the culture broth of the
constructed transformants. (C) HPLC analysis of the mycelial extract
of AO-nghhA. In (B) and (C), chromatograms monitored at 254 nm
are presented. (D) Proposed biosynthetic pathway of 1.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. NghhA-catalyzed β-lactonization. (A) GC-MS analysis of
NghhA-His6 reaction. (B) β-Lactonization of 3. (C) GC-MS analysis
of the KS−AT domain. In (A) and (C), chromatograms extracted at
m/z 95 are presented. (D) Docking analysis of the acyl−KS complex
using the AlphaFold2-constructed model. See Figure S5 for a detailed
view.
